question.prompt: To estimate the number of fish in a pond, 100 fish are first caught, marked, and released. After they have mixed thoroughly, 200 fish are caught, of which 5 are marked. Estimate approximately how many fish are in the pond.

solutions.explanation: The fraction of marked fish in the sample is \(5/200\), approximately equal to \(100\div\text{total number}\) for all the fish. From \(100\div\text{total number}=5\div200\), the total number is 4000 fish.
solutions.title: Match the marked-fish proportions
